in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum de origine Hebraica, derivatum a Tobias
in_latin.long_meaning: Tobrianus, nomen Christianum, derivatum a Tobias, nomine prophetae, qui apparuit in libro apocrypho de Tobias. in_english.long_meaning: Tobrian is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew name Tobias, meaning 'my God is good' or 'God is my salvation'. The name Tobias is found in the biblical book of Tobit, where the prophet Tobias appears. In Christian tradition, the name Tobrian signifies 'God is my salvation', which is a grateful name in the Christian church, seeking salvation from an omnipotent God. The name has been used in the Christian church throughout its history, although it is not found in the canonical scriptures. Tobrian is a name that carries hope and trust in God's goodness and salvation.
